title: Enable internet sharing with firewalld
summary: Configure firewalld to allow traffic forwarding between the internal (client) and external (internet) zones, enabling internet sharing.
prerequisites: Static IP is set on the client interface

steps.explain: Assign the internet interface to the 'external' zone permanently.

placeholders.name: INTERNET_INTERFACE
placeholders.description: Name of the interface connected to the internet

steps.explain: Assign the client interface to the 'internal' zone permanently.

placeholders.name: CLIENT_INTERFACE
placeholders.description: Name of the interface connected to the client(s)

steps.explain: Create a new policy named 'int2ext' to manage traffic between zones.
Set the ingress zone of the policy to 'internal'.
Set the egress zone of the policy to 'external'.
Set the target of the policy to ACCEPT to allow traffic flow.
Reload firewalld to apply the changes.

rollback.explain: To undo this, delete the policy using 'firewall-cmd --permanent --delete-policy int2ext', reset interface zones to their previous values, and reload firewalld.

warnings: Changing zones affects firewall rules applied to those interfaces.
Ensure firewalld is running and enabled before applying these changes.
